text: Confirmed and filed #6579: COPY TO TYPE CSV exports a quoted CRLF field, but APPEND FROM TYPE CSV splits physical lines before parsing quotes, turning one row into two (runtime reproduction: RECCOUNT()=2; values line1 and line2). Issue is open, owner-authored, and labeled bug/runtime/agent-approved. No production files changed. Related existing leads checked: #3950/#5993 were exact duplicates for STRTRAN nFlags and ALINES flags; no CSV multiline duplicate found.
